name: Create or Update Item { Item }
purpose: Creates or updates one Item (product or service, with QuickBooks Online field names) from a JSON payload inside a transaction. It requires name and incomeAccountRef.value, then copies the listed pricing, account, SKU, sub-item, tax, quantity and QBO id fields onto the Item record chosen by id (a new record when the id does not exist). Returns {Id}.
